limits.notes: Stricter rule: yellow >120, red >140 sustained; re-check 2 min.
% of 600 mSv career limit. Advisory (blue) at ≥25%; caution 50–80%; warning >80%.
Colour 4–5 yellow; ≥6 red. Also yellow if body mass falls >2%.
Green = EMU regulator set-point 4.2–4.4; yellow within ±0.25 psi of 4.3; red outside. Real EMU alarm limits not public.
Yellow >3 to <8 mmHg (slow down); red ≥8 mmHg or any symptom (purge valve as trained); always purge at 12.4 mmHg.
Minutes. Red below 30 min = into the EMU 30-min reserve.
No public ranges. Show trend only.
